display.purpose: Screen titles and primary pane headings. At most one per screen.

headline.purpose: Section headers, panel titles within a screen.

title.purpose: Card headers, form section labels, named workspace regions.

body.purpose: Primary paragraph text, descriptions, help copy. Cap at 65–75ch on reading surfaces.

label.purpose: Badges, chip labels, table column headers, status indicators. All-caps forbidden; semibold carries the weight.

mono.purpose: Terminal IDs, receipt amounts, barcode values, audit reference strings, transaction UUIDs.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Default state for all surfaces. No resting shadow on interactive elements.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Hairline depth for inline chips and tight status indicators.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Mid-level utility shadow; rarely used directly.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Standard card elevation. Tinted toward Midnight Ink to stay cool rather than generic gray.

shadows.name: pane
shadows.purpose: Modal-adjacent panels, the pairing screen pane.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and drawers. Unmistakably above the page.

shadows.name: inset
shadows.purpose: Sunken wells — PIN keypad recess, numeric input backgrounds where tactile depth is needed.

motion.name: duration-1
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: hover bg fills, badge dot pulse onset.

motion.name: duration-2
motion.purpose: Standard state transitions: button hover, border-color shifts, input focus.

motion.name: duration-3
motion.purpose: Panel slides, nav rail label fade.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard exit easing for state transitions. Expo-style; never bounce or elastic.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Bidirectional transitions — panel toggle, rail expand/collapse.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Below this breakpoint the nav rail is hidden.

breakpoints.name: rail-expand
breakpoints.purpose: At this breakpoint the rail expands from 84px icon-only to 248px with labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single commitment button per context — confirm sale, sign in, apply.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background-color: #1f4e7a; border: 1px solid #1f4e7a; border-radius: 10px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #163d61; border-color: #163d61; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(31,78,122,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled, .ds-btn-primary[aria-disabled='true'] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action alongside a primary — cancel, back, secondary confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d8dfe7; border-radius: 10px; color: #0f1d2e; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(31,78,122,0.5); color: #1f4e7a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2e7da3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Permanent or financial-consequence actions — void, force-close, delete. Use sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background-color: #b32e36; border: 1px solid #b32e36; border-radius: 10px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background-color: #8e2329; border-color: #8e2329; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(179,46,54,0.18); } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Base text field — barcode entry, name search, numeric amounts.
components.css: .ds-input-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { display: block; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f1d2e; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0f1d2e; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d8dfe7; border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #1f4e7a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,78,122,0.20); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b32e36; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true']:focus-visible { border-color: #b32e36; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(179,46,54,0.20); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation Rail Entry
components.description: Primary navigation item inside the dark rail sidebar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-entry { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; height: 48px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; color: #cdd6e0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-entry:hover { background-color: #162a40; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2e7da3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-entry--active { background-color: #1f4e7a; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-entry--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 4px; height: 24px; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background-color: #2e7da3; } .ds-nav-entry--active:hover { background-color: #163d61; } .ds-nav-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav-label { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.description: Bounded content region for operator panels, pairing flows, form sections.

components.name: Status Banner — Offline
components.description: Full-width persistent banner shown when the terminal is offline. Never auto-dismisses.
components.html: Offline — selling from local queue
components.css: .ds-status-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-status-banner--offline { background-color: #f7e2e3; border-bottom-color: rgba(179,46,54,0.25); color: #b32e36; } .ds-status-banner--degraded { background-color: #fbf0db; border-bottom-color: rgba(184,118,0,0.25); color: #b87600; } .ds-status-banner--syncing { background-color: #e1f0f5; border-bottom-color: rgba(30,111,140,0.25); color: #1e6f8c; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped inline status label with a color-dot secondary signal for shift state, connection state, operator role.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; background-color: currentColor; } .ds-badge--info    { background-color: #e1f0f5; color: #1e6f8c; } .ds-badge--success { background-color: #e7f5ee; color: #1f8a5b; } .ds-badge--warning { background-color: #fbf0db; color: #b87600; } .ds-badge--danger  { background-color: #f7e2e3; color: #b32e36; } .ds-badge--neutral { background-color: #f3f6fa; color: #5b6b7c; }

narrative.overview:
POS-Pulse is a precision instrument, not a consumer product. Its visual language is calibrated around one question: does the operator know the true state of every operation? The interface is built from clean white surfaces, a commanding navy command rail, and a restrained accent vocabulary that preserves the visual weight of information. Every interaction is keyboard-first; every state change is legible without mouse proximity. The palette is determinedly light — pharmacy floor environments require opaque, well-lit surfaces that read under overhead fluorescent lighting, not atmospheric depth.

The system is Arabic-first: RTL layout is the default, and the font stack gracefully degrades from Inter Variable to Segoe UI to system-UI without introducing a proprietary dependency that could cause a visual regression on a paired Windows 10 terminal. Motion is state-change-only: transitions confirm actions, they do not entertain.

The design explicitly rejects consumer SaaS aesthetics, glassmorphism, dark-mode defaults, SaaS metric-hero templates, and generic AI tool aesthetics. If a screen could be mistaken for a Notion dashboard or a startup landing page, something has gone wrong.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: navy primary + teal accent occupy less than 15% of any screen; the rest is neutral surface
Flat-by-default with structural shadow for elevation hierarchy
Inter Variable as the single sans typeface; weight contrast carries hierarchy
All interactive elements meet the 44 × 44 CSS px touch-target floor
State banners are persistent, not toast-based
The dark navigation rail is the one intentionally drenched surface

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: The teal accent (#2e7da3) appears only as a navigational marker (the active-state tab) and a focus-ring fallback. It is not used as a button color, badge color, or decorative fill. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Status-Color Containment Rule
rules.body: Status colors (success, warning, danger, info) appear only on their designated surfaces (badges, status banners, alert callouts). They are never used as decorative fills, hover accents, or brand colors on primary actions.

rules.name: The No-Second-Font Rule
rules.body: Inter Tight and any secondary display typeface are rejected by spec (FR-052). Weight contrast alone carries the display hierarchy. A secondary proprietary font introduces a Windows font dependency that causes fallback regressions on paired terminals.

rules.name: The Tight-Display Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline headings use letter-spacing −0.01em and −0.008em respectively — not Inter Tight as a separate face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface starts flat. Shadows appear only as a structural response to layering (card above workspace, dialog above everything) or to state (hover on a card signals lift). Purely decorative shadows are prohibited.

rules.name: The Single Primary Rule
rules.body: No screen or modal shall have more than one primary-intent button visible at once. When two confirmations are needed, sequence them.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards do not contain cards. If content inside a card needs grouping, use spacing, borders, or background color shifts — never a child card component.

rules.name: The Persistent Banner Rule
rules.body: Status banners are never toasts. If a hardware or connectivity condition requires the operator's attention, the banner stays until the condition resolves. Ephemeral toasts are reserved for transient acknowledgement of user-initiated actions.

dos: Do use Command Navy (#1f4e7a) as the single primary action color. One primary per context.
Do keep the workspace background Near-White (#fbfcfd), never pure white.
Do use status banners (full-width, persistent) for ambient operational state.
Do surface the true state of every operation with a visible, non-dismissable indicator.
Do meet the 44 × 44 CSS px touch-target floor on every interactive element.
Do accompany every color-coded state with an icon or text label — color alone is not a state signal.
Do use negative letter-spacing on headings (−0.01em for display) — not a secondary font.
Do apply --shadow-card to standard cards and --shadow-overlay to dialogs.
Do use the inset shadow for sunken well surfaces — PIN keypad recesses, numeric input backgrounds.
Do keep the navigation rail as the only intentionally dark surface.
donts: Don't use consumer SaaS aesthetics (Notion, Intercom, Loom gradient heroes).
Don't use glassmorphism or backdrop-blur decoratively.
Don't apply dark mode by default — the one light theme is deliberate.
Don't build SaaS metric-hero templates (big number, gradient accent, shadow flourish).
Don't use identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use the Teal Marker accent (#2e7da3) as a button fill, badge color, or decorative accent.
Don't use status colors as brand or decorative fills.
Don't use auto-dismissing toasts for operational state (offline, degraded, hardware fault).
Don't apply modal dialogs as a first-resort pattern.
Don't use generic AI-tool aesthetics (purple gradients, neon-on-dark, glassmorphism-as-brand).
